name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity on all focusable elements. This ensures keyboard users see where they are without breaking the page’s color scheme. The glow improves visibility on light backgrounds where a solid ring might blend in. Trade-off: the glow adds slight blur that some users may dislike, but it’s a small cost for universal clarity.

name: Reader
text: The 20% glow fails WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds—#005FCC at 20% opacity drops to ~1.8:1 contrast against white, invisible to many users. A better fix: use a 2px solid ring at 4.5:1 contrast (#005FCC) with a 1px inner shadow at 50% opacity to soften edges without sacrificing clarity. Settle it with a live contrast test on a busy background.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast on all backgrounds. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for every color scheme and ensures keyboard users see their position clearly. The trade-off is a slightly sharper ring that some may find less subtle, but clarity beats aesthetics for accessibility.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-1940, worker-1904 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: A 4.5:1 solid ring risks disappearing on busy backgrounds—busy UI often has adjacent colors near #005FCC, making the ring vanish. Better: keep the 2px solid ring at 4.5:1 but add a 1px inner shadow at 30% opacity (#005FCC) to soften edges without contrast loss. Settle it with a live contrast checker on the darkest and lightest backgrounds in the design system.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px inner shadow at 30% opacity (#005FCC) on all focusable elements. Deliver a tested, WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant focus style in EXCAVA’s CSS with live contrast checks; owner: accessibility-w1.
